39-01-2025.crimp_contact: 39-00-0039 loose or 39-00-0038 reel; two contacts total, according to the selected process
39-01-2025.housing_dimension_scope: Molex SD-5557-003 J4, sheets 1–2 explicitly include 39-01-2025. Nominal housing length and two-circuit width are not a full mated housing solid or tolerance stack.
39-01-2025.header_contact_axis_scope: Nominal mating-contact axes derived from the dimensioned header front view, not the complete-mate roof or a gathered loom endpoint. Exact wire-exit plane and terminal float remain separate dimensions.

39-00-0039.hand_tool_scope: For 63819-0900 and 20-24 AWG profile, 1.70–2.30 mm insulation is recommended to achieve IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2; this differs from the terminal maximum of 3.10 mm. Conductor-crimp height is a reference; pull-force testing excludes insulation grip.
39-00-0039.current_scope: Component catalog maximum, not a continuous console or assembled harness rating.

39-00-0038.description: Mini-Fit Jr tin-plated female contact on reel; alternate packaging of 39-00-0039 for automatic or semi-automatic applicator

39-00-0038.applicator_scope: Use reel contact 39-00-0038 with the maker-listed 63902-4900 for measured 2.30–2.50 mm insulation, installed in a compatible press. The cited crimp dimensions are maker guidelines and the insulation range is an IPC-A-620 recommendation, not proof that a particular assembly passes. Verify crimp setup, tensile test without insulation support, retention and the finished loom.

DC_precrimped_alternative.description: Molex factory-crimped Mini-Fit Jr 5556 female-to-pigtail leads in the same 5557 housing; not substituted for the selected LAPP harness.
DC_precrimped_alternative.length_scope: Drawing length L is 150 +/- 5 mm over the lead assembly; it is not a measured seated wire-exit-to-jack distance.
DC_precrimped_alternative.pigtail_finish: Molex drawing specifies free end stripped, twisted and tinned over 5 +/- 1 mm, maximum tinning diameter 1.25 mm; cutting to length requires re-establishing the jack termination.
DC_precrimped_alternative.housing_compatibility: Molex lists the Mini-Fit Jr 5557 receptacle family as a mating housing for these leads. Confirm contacts seat and latch in the specific 39-01-2025 housing.
DC_precrimped_alternative.qualification_scope: Factory crimp avoids the selected hand-tool insulation-diameter issue but does not prove the jack solder joint or the completed loom. Obtain the actual wire's maximum OD, bend radius, resistance, conductor and insulation temperature rating, final contact float, route clearance, cut length and physical assembly before substitution. A nominal 20 AWG designation alone does not establish these properties.

DC_hookup_wire_alternative.description: 20 AWG (7/28) stranded tinned copper hook-up wire, PVC insulation; 100 ft reels, red and black.
DC_hookup_wire_alternative.resistance_scope: 10.1 ohm per 1000 ft nominal for engineering use only, not a maximum conductor resistance.
DC_hookup_wire_alternative.route_screen: The complete published diameter tolerance falls inside the selected hand tool's 20–24 AWG recommended insulation range. The existing R10 path violates this wire's 10-diameter bend requirement, so it cannot be substituted into the selected route. One exploratory R18.288 path intersected modeled shell, a fixing screw and a J302 allocation, and the two wire solids intersected. This rejects that candidate path only; it is not a proof that all compliant paths are impossible. The actual supplier geometry, connector float, wire departure, strain relief and physical crimp require qualification.
DC_hookup_wire_alternative.power_scope: The present 5 A design basis is not an established continuous-current rating of this wire, tool, connector, solder joint or finished loom; application and temperature must be qualified.
DC_hookup_wire_alternative.availability_scope: Maker lists red RD005 and black BK005 variants. Distributor listings do not confirm an available order or lot.
